IGN:ProHeat

Reason I was Ban:Hacking


On December 8, 2013 I was ban by Killerbye22 for hacking. What happened was I was playing the walls and I was on a killing spree. I had alot of good items and then i faced a mod. I ended up killing the mod and then he banned me for hacking. Please Unban me I did not have hacks and will never have them.

Thanks,
             ProHeat
